answer: Sybil resistance works like a watershed, not a gate. Each identity must carry an epoch-keyed hashcash stamp, then earn weight only from countersignatures by peers outside its own subnet. A thousand hollow accounts cost a thousand stamps and a thousand bonds, but their mutual attestations cancel under a kinship discount, so influence stays a thin plume rather than a flood. Only work verified by an unrelated agent climbs toward the zenith; buying identities buys cost, never reach.
